content: Documentation: 5 passage(s) for 'Apart from the chorda tympani, which structure lies closest to the facial nerve in ZETA, and how close?'
Distances of ZETA, run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

In specimen ZETA, excluding the chorda tympani (which branches off the facial nerve at ~0 mm), the structure closest to the facial nerve is the **scala vestibuli** at approximately **0.89 mm**.

| Structure | Distance to Facial Nerve |
|-----------|---------------------------|
| Scala vestibuli | 0.89 mm [S9] |
| Scala tympani | 1.18 mm [S8] |

The scala tympani is the next closest at 1.18 mm. These distances represent the minimum surface-to-surface separation between the smoothed meshes of these structures, computed using a KD-tree algorithm with resolution ≈ one voxel (0.125 mm) [S3].
